references.text: In the cleansing of leprosy, cedar wood, scarlet thread, and hyssop were also used together, showing a parallel ritual practice for purification.
The cleansing ritual for a house with leprosy included the same elements: cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet thread, which were used to cleanse from impurity.
Hyssop was used to apply blood on the doorposts at Passover, showing hyssop's function in purification and protection.
David asks to be cleansed with hyssop, linking hyssop to spiritual cleansing from sin.
The book of Hebrews mentions scarlet wool and hyssop in connection with the blood of the covenant, linking this cleansing ritual to Christ's perfect sacrifice.
